head: McDonald's Discord order: get McDelivery through Uber Eats in chat
dek: McDonald's added an Order McDonald's activity to Discord that lets you order McDelivery through Uber Eats in a server, channel or direct message, without leaving the chat or your game. It was announced on 18 November.
details: You start it from Discord's Apps and Activities menu and pick Order Food. The same activity has a mini-game, Fast Lane Feast, where you collect virtual burgers and fries for a leaderboard while you wait. The report doesn't say which countries or devices it works in or whether there are discounts.
where: Discord, from 18 November; countries not stated
means: If you game with friends on Discord, you can order food in the same window instead of switching to the Uber Eats app.
todo: In a server, channel or DM, open Apps and Activities, start Order McDonald's and pick Order Food. Check that delivery works where you live before you count on it.
